look_here_first: Start with the head: curlytop gumweed is typically rayless, with only yellow disc florets surrounded by many narrow spreading to ascending resin-gland-tipped phyllaries. Vegetative parts are strongly gland-dotted and aromatic.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: biennial to short-lived subshrub; glabrous to nearly glabrous gland-dotted shoots; sessile somewhat clasping serrate leaves; strongly aromatic when crushed; ray florets absent; many narrow spreading to ascending phyllaries with resinous tips; disc florets yellow; usually solitary terminal heads

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Rayless yellow head + gland-dotted aromatic foliage + narrow spreading resin-tipped phyllaries is the strongest field package.
